name: Chara
description: A naked-eye star 8.4 parsecs away, 1.1 times the Sun's width: its disc was measured with the CHARA Array.

radius.source: Boyajian et al. (2012), ApJ 746, 101, HD 109358: radius in solar radii, from the limb-darkened angular diameter 1.238 +/- 0.03 mas (CHARA) and the Hipparcos parallax, 1.123 +/- 0.028

mass.source: Boyajian et al. (2012), ApJ 746, 101, HD 109358: mass in solar masses, from Yonsei-Yale isochrones at the measured radius and temperature (a model value), 0.852 +/- 0.023

temperature.source: Boyajian et al. (2012), ApJ 746, 101, HD 109358: effective temperature in K, from the angular diameter and the bolometric flux, 5653 +/- 72

distance.source: Boyajian et al. (2012), ApJ 746, 101, HD 109358: the Hipparcos parallax the radius was computed with (van Leeuwen 2007), 118.49 +/- 0.2 mas, inverted

text.card: A naked-eye star 8 parsecs away whose disc the CHARA Array measured: 1.1 times the Sun's width.
text.introduction: Its disc spans 1.238 milliarcseconds, which gives 1.123 solar radii and 5,653 K at its surface.
text.locator: Tables 5 and 10, HD 109358: limb-darkened diameter, R, Teff
